submitted.rationale: EQE peaks on the Pb-rich side of the line. Index 2 (Sb 0.256) had the highest EQE at 0.0198%. The neighbours on both sides were lower: Sb 0.15 gave 0.0144% and Sb 0.32 gave 0.0098%. The Sb-rich compositions near the Pb2Sb2O7 and PbSb2O6 phases were one to two orders of magnitude lower. MEGNet predicts band gaps of about 2.5–2.7 eV for these phases, which is above the 2.1 eV illumination.
